title: Extended Enchantment Levelz
description: This resource pack extends the roman numerals that go up to only ten in enchant levels
body: If you ever gave yourself an item with larger than 10 enchantment levels, it does something like this enchantment.level.NUMBER. But this resource pack can fix that! This adds enchantment level roman numerals all the way up to 255! (max level is 255) THIS RESOURCE PACK WAS MADE FOR 1.21.8, BUT IT CAN STILL BE LOADED ONTO AND WORK WITH NEWER VERSIONS (like other resource packs.)
